name: Mutou Rikurou
source: The protagonist. After his parents died when he was young, he was taken in by the Mikoshiba family and grew up together with [url=/c44987]Iori[/url] like they were real siblings. Due to his demon blood Rikurou has an unnaturally high sex drive, but this doesn't stop him from trying to live his life normally.
